text: Since $0<\theta_{i}<\pi$ , we have $-1<\cos\theta_{i}<1$ , and hence $1<\lambda_{i}<\kappa$ . As $A=O\Lambda O^{\top}$ with $O$ orthogonal, this gives $I_{d}\preceq A\preceq\kappa I_{d}$ .

The potential $V_{A}(x)=\tfrac{1}{2}x^{\top}Ax$ is $C^{\infty}$ with Hessian $\nabla^{2}V_{A}(x)=A$ . Thus it is $1$ -strongly convex and $\kappa$ -smooth. Moreover, $V_{A}(0)=0$ and $V_{A}(x)\geq\tfrac{1}{2}\|x\|^{2}>0$ for $x\neq 0$ , so $0$ is its unique minimizer.
